rows.test: W5-CEILING, perfect source knowledge vs an 8-target pilot (spec/CEILING.md)
rows.result: Analysis: the W5 transfer line stops in all four directions (spec/FIXES_P2.md C1–C3)
rows.meaning: By the registered rule agent → person passes: perfect source knowledge beats an 8-target pilot by +0.213 per tick. That room cannot be credited to the source: a source-free rule (the target's stabilising archetype everywhere, read from the pilot's own ticks) reaches the same +0.240 (review P2-1). person → agent: no better than the pilot; agent v2 → person: no value; person → agent v2: harmful (−0.050). No successor is planned; any future transfer test needs a source-free arm (results/ceiling.md)
